verdict.rationale: Bugbot automatically reviews every PR and every PR update in the background (docs-1, docs-31, docs-13, docs-28), with configurable effort levels and organization-wide rules. Cursor's own docs pair Cloud Agents opening PRs with Bugbot reviewing them (docs-12), and community users report it catches genuine bugs reliably (comm-3, comm-5). One user reports it flip-flopping on its own suggested fix (comm-1), which raises a consistency concern. Missing for 10: explicit positioning or features for verifying agent-authored PRs specifically, evidence of throughput at high PR volume, and corroboration of consistent verdicts.
